decisions.reason: Purchasing the campaign domain does not change the mailbox requirement's Gmail compatibility state.
The domain purchase neither changes nor resumes the deferred automated email campaign.
The purchased email domain does not alter the LinkedIn campaign's channel, automation mode, or platform.
The domain purchase does not change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization requirement.
The domain registration fact does not change MeetAlfred configuration or its selected subscription plan.
The domain purchase does not modify or resume the deferred Zapier configuration.
The domain purchase does not affect the prohibition on using production leads or the preferred test identity.
Registering a campaign domain does not change the obligation to preserve existing MeetAlfred integrations and campaigns.
The domain purchase does not change or resume the deferred silent-lead follow-up workflow.
The domain purchase does not affect visibility of email or LinkedIn communication history in HubSpot.
The campaign domain and registrar do not alter Apollo contact-enrichment provider, fields, or automation mode.
